en: An old sepia postcard showing a rural inn or large house with two stories and a gabled roof, located beside a dirt road and surrounded by wooded hills. A group of people, including men, women, and children, pose in front of the building and by an adjoining barn or outbuilding. Logs lie near the road, and the setting appears to be a small village in a forested area. The caption in red German text at the bottom reads "Gruss aus Grünberg bei Petschau." Publisher information and a printer's mark appear at the bottom and right edges.
